== January 5, 2012 ==
* Increased casting time to 1 second.
* Increased cost to 10 Energy. 
* Increased recharge to 20 seconds.
* Changed functionality to: "''Invoke the power of the Dragon. For 8 seconds, you and target ally are enchanted with Double Dragon. Adjacent foes are dealt 5...30 fire damage each second. Additionally, when you or your ally use skills that target a foe, that foe is set on fire for 0...3 seconds.''"

== December 11, 2008 ==
* Energy cost reduced to 5, recharge time reduced to 15 seconds. 
* Functionality changed to: "''All nearby foes are struck for 7..112 fire damage. For 10..25 seconds, your Fire Magic attribute is increased by +0..2.''"
